PHU QUOC Trip 🇻🇳 | 6 Nights 7 Days Itinerary & ₹2 Lakh Budget | Complete Vietnam Travel Guide

Planning a trip to Phu Quoc, Vietnam? 🇻🇳🌴
In this video, I am sharing my complete 6 Nights 7 Days Phu Quoc itinerary, including hotels, sightseeing, island tours, food, local transportation and the overall budget.
From luxury stays at Wyndham Grand Phu Quoc to the 4 Island Tour, Hòn Thơm Cable Car, Sunset Town, Grand World Gondola Ride, Starfish Beach and Vin-Wonders — I am sharing everything about our trip.
I have also shared the complete trip cost, including flights, hotels, food, local transportation and entry fees.

💰 Total Budget: Around ₹2 Lakh
So if you are planning a Phu Quoc or Vietnam trip, this video will help you understand the itinerary, expenses and places you can cover.
Watch till the end and let me know in the comments — which place from our Phu Quoc trip would you love to visit? ❤️
